# Ordinary

![Ordinary function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/ordinary-differential-equations/00_Repertoire%20ODE.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Ordinary differential equations: coupled real numerical trajectories, constant-coefficient linear Numeric/Symbolic solutions and residual DAE. The supplied 00 icon belongs to this child of Differential Equations, outside Elementary.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Ordinaires**

Équations différentielles ordinaires : trajectoires réelles couplées, solutions linéaires Numeric/Symbolic et DAE résiduelles. Le SVG 00 appartient à Ordinary, enfant de Differential Equations hors Elementary.

</details>

| [ODE Solver](../../math/ode/solve.md) | Solves X'=F(t,X) from initial_values. Formula supplies equations, declared state variables and a time name. Default method rk45 is Dormand–Prince 5(4), distinct from Cash–Karp. Real choices: euler, rk2, rk3, rk4, rk23, rk45 and bdf. bdf is the documented FROG BDF2 backend, not a claim of reproducing the NI BDF implementation. cash_karp54 is an explicit additional choice. Adams–Moulton, Rosenbrock and Discrete States Only are unavailable and disabled with an explanation; imported requests return a diagnostic without substitution. Parameters: t0=0,tf=1,step=.1,method=rk45,atol=1e-9,rtol=1e-6,initial_step=.01,min_step=1e-12,max_step=.1. Fixed methods use step; adaptive methods use tolerances and adaptive bounds. tf&gt;t0, positive steps, nonnegative tolerances not both zero. Real f64 coupled systems, not element-wise batch lifting. Vectors are rank 1; matrices and multistate trajectories are actual rank-2 Arrays, not nominal Matrix transport. Values[row,column] is state column at Times[row]. Explicit exception: Linear nth Order Numeric returns only x(t) as a rank-1 Array, without its derivatives. Borrowed Variant user data is opaque to the f64 ODE state profile and may preserve exact common typed payloads, including I128/U128 lexical values, without numeric conversion. No complex transport, implicit batch, dimensional broadcasting or scalar lifting. Formula and FROG Reference are explicitly selected persisted identities sharing one palette artwork. Common connector IDs survive switching instances. ODE Solver and DAE use error in/out clusters; the legacy RK4, CK, Euler and linear functions retain error:i32 (zero means success). ticks:u32 is elapsed calculation milliseconds, not step count or simulated time. Invalid preconditions return empty results; a stopped integration retains accepted rows with an explicit nonzero diagnostic. Resource limits, cancellation, invalid references, nonfinite values and unavailable methods never become plausible zero-valued success. Classic LabVIEW connector documentation and mathematical algorithms; no measured NI runtime parity or confirmed NXG graphical signatures. FROG owns endpoint_policy=clip, long declared identifiers, CK accuracy mapping, repeated-root and Jordan support. Local execution uses the existing immutable authored graph and its owned Highlight worker, through Play with or without the bulb. The public-source LLVM compiled target corridor does not admit these aggregate signatures yet and rejects them explicitly; there is no substituted provider. |
| [ODE Solver](../../math/ode/solve/reference.md) | FROG Reference instance. A borrowed strict Static FROG Reference with parameter IDs t, X, data supplies the residual or derivative and diagnostic. Resolve and validate the private immutable authored graph once, retain opaque typed data for the integration, reject wrong dimensions and do not close the borrowed reference. This is a bounded pure callback profile: numeric functions except random generation, math.exponential.*, math.trigonometric.*, cluster.bundle_by_name/unbundle_by_name, variant.to_variant and variant.to_data, plus source and indicator terminals. | [Linear nth Order Numeric](../../math/ode/linear_nth_numeric.md) | Homogeneous normalized constant-coefficient scalar equation x^(n)+a[n-1]*x^(n-1)+...+a[0]*x=0. A=[a0,...,a(n-1)], ascending derivative order; leading coefficient is implicitly 1. X0=[x(t0),x'(t0),...]. n is equation order. Companion matrix exponential gives only x(t): output X is rank 1, not all derivatives. number of points&gt;=2 includes both bounds; tf&gt;t0. Repeated roots are supported as a FROG improvement over the documented NI limitation. Real f64 coupled systems, not element-wise batch lifting. Vectors are rank 1; matrices and multistate trajectories are actual rank-2 Arrays, not nominal Matrix transport. Values[row,column] is state column at Times[row]. | [DAE Radau 5th Order](../../math/dae/radau_iia5.md) | Solves residual R(t,X,dX)=0 using genuine three-stage implicit Radau IIA order 5 and nonlinear Newton solves. A residual is not an explicit derivative and Radau is not BDF. Formula declares residual equations, state names, derivative names and time.
